echo "=== TOOL VERSIONS ==="; node --version; npm --version; /usr/share/dotnet/dotnet --version
echo; echo "=== CONTAINERS ==="; docker ps --format "table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}"
echo; echo "=== ENDPOINTS ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "frontend(4200): %{http_code}\n" --max-time 10 http://localhost:4200/
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "backend swagger(5000): %{http_code}\n" --max-time 10 http://localhost:5000/swagger/index.html
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "keycloak(8080): %{http_code}\n" --max-time 10 http://localhost:8080/realms/my-realm/.well-known/openid-configuration
echo; echo "=== DB TABLES ==="; docker exec strassennamen-sql /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P 'Strassen!Passw0rd' -C -d Strassennamen -h -1 -Q "SET NOCOUNT ON; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES;" 2>/dev/null | head -1
echo; echo "=== FRONTEND DIST ==="; ls /workspace/src/Frontend/Strassennamen/dist 2>/dev/null | head
echo; echo "=== BACKEND BIN ==="; ls /workspace/src/Backend/Lecos.Strassennamen.RestAPI/bin/Debug/net9.0/*.dll 2>/dev/null | head -3
